description: This file defines the PackageController class, which manages package-related actions in the ModuleInstall component of SuiteCRM. It handles package search, retrieval, download, installation, updates, and documentation functions, acting as a central controller for package management operations.

classes.name: PackageController
classes.description: Controller class managing package operations such as search, retrieval, installation, and updates within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the PackageController with a new instance of PackageManager.

methods.name: performBasicSearch
methods.description: Performs a basic search for packages based on a search term and node ID.

methods.name: getPackages
methods.description: Retrieves packages belonging to a specific category.

methods.name: getReleases
methods.description: Obtains a list of available releases, filtering by category, package, and types.

methods.name: getPromotion
methods.description: Retrieves a promotion from the depot.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Downloads a specified package release, performing setup if successful.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Retrieves subcategories under a given category node.

methods.name: getNodes
methods.description: Retrieves module loader category packages under a specified category.

methods.name: checkForUpdates
methods.description: Checks for available updates for installed objects and patches from the depot.

methods.name: getLicenseText
methods.description: Retrieves and displays the license text for a specified file.

methods.name: getPackagesInStaging
methods.description: Builds a list of modules currently staged for installation.

methods.name: performInstall
methods.description: Performs installation of a package from a specified hash/file.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Authenticates a user with provided credentials and server info.

methods.name: getDocumentation
methods.description: Retrieves documentation for a specific package and release.

methods.name: rmMetaFile
methods.description: Removes metadata files associated with a package, like manifest or icon files.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a package file and associated metadata files.
